stem: A program office needs to acquire cybersecurity support in less than 90 days, and the team is debating whether market research can be abbreviated to save schedule. What is the best contracting action?

choices.text: Reuse prior-year vendor assumptions without validating current market capability or pricing conditions.
Document current market research findings under FAR Part 10 before finalizing the acquisition approach.
Issue the solicitation first and collect market research documentation only if protest risk increases.
Limit outreach to the incumbent because continuity concerns outweigh pre-award market analysis.

explanation:
Why correct: This option applies FAR Part 10 and keeps the action compliant and defensible.

Relevant section: https://www.acquisition.gov/far/10.001

stem: Your team is considering a brand-name approach for schedule reasons and plans to justify reduced competition after proposals are received. What is the best contracting action?

choices.text: Restrict sources to known contractors first and justify limiting competition after proposal receipt.
Use urgency as a default basis to narrow competition without preparing the required approval package.
Adopt a brand-name-only strategy immediately and defer the justification until contract administration.
Promote full and open competition and document any authorized exception before award under FAR Part 6.

explanation:
Why correct: This option applies FAR Part 6 and keeps the action compliant and defensible.

stem: The office is packaging several needs into one action and assumes simplified procedures still apply because each component seems routine. What is the best contracting action?

choices.text: Use simplified procedures above applicable thresholds when mission timelines are compressed.
Use FAR Part 13 thresholds, solicitation methods, and documentation requirements before award.
Solicit one vendor and complete price reasonableness documentation after performance starts.
Bundle unrelated requirements solely to keep the buy inside a preferred simplified path.

explanation:
Why correct: This option applies FAR Part 13 and keeps the action compliant and defensible.

stem: The source selection schedule is compressed, and leadership suggests skipping key negotiation planning steps to meet award dates. What is the best contracting action?

stem: After award, the requiring activity asks the contractor to start changed work immediately while the pricing and scope determination are still pending. What is the best contracting action?
